publication_type: bilingual dedicated dossier plus sitewide red correction, correction-register entry and structured-evidence update

controlling_proposition.es: No está acreditado que LPB desistiera voluntariamente. Está acreditado que se presentó un desistimiento en su nombre. Por Derecho alega atribución procesal falsa, falta de autorización, perjuicio deliberado a la masa y agencia funcional de facto para el perímetro CAM/Acosta Matos; la autoría, autoridad, intención y responsabilidad deben determinarse con el expediente certificado.
controlling_proposition.en: It is not established that LPB voluntarily withdrew. It is established that a withdrawal was filed in its name. Por Derecho alleges false procedural attribution, lack of authority, deliberate estate harm and de facto functional agency for the CAM/Acosta Matos perimeter; authorship, authority, intent and liability require determination from the certified file.

sitewide_scope: Insolvency Administrator gatekeeper and loyalty-breakpoint routes
criminal, DP 1901, ICALPA and case-control routes

evidence_boundary.verified: The 12 January disclosure order, CAM's authority objection, 25 January Administrator control of counsel/procurator, withdrawal filing in LPB's name, CAM non-opposition and 5 March closure are supported by primary documents.
evidence_boundary.not_established: An authentic voluntary LPB decision, the withdrawal drafter/signer/filer, LexNET chain, specific authority, Article 51.2 authorisation, LPB hearing and estate-interest analysis are not established by the currently available file.
evidence_boundary.allegation: False attribution, deliberate estate harm, de facto functional agency for CAM/Acosta Matos, individual involvement of José Daniel Acosta Matos or Laura Patricia Acosta Matos, and criminal liability are Por Derecho allegations requiring proof; they are not final judicial findings.

p0_evidence: Complete PP 1041 withdrawal pleading and annexes.
Drafter, signatory, filer and LexNET user/certificate metadata.
Specific power relied upon for LPB.
Article 51.2 application, insolvency-court authorisation and LPB hearing record.
Counterfactual finance, convenio, payment, redemption and alternative-route file.
publication_rule: Remove the unqualified phrase 'LPB withdrew'. Use 'a withdrawal was filed in LPB's name' and separately classify verified fact, Por Derecho allegation, inference and pending judicial/criminal determination.

live_verification.note: PR_OPEN means source is under review in PR 576. Merge, deployment and live verification require separate observable evidence.
